implemented: Append-only, hash-chained bounded research journal with a maximum of 256 variants per run.
Frozen mechanism source digest, seed, parameter catalogue and run timestamp.
Exactly one evaluated/failed/skipped/aborted outcome per declared variant; close requires complete accounting.
Bounded daily random search writes its complete variant results and records aborted outcomes on evaluator exceptions.
Research-only and auto-promotion-disabled flags are mandatory journal invariants.

tests.result: Focused suite: 8 passed; after refreshing the strategy inventory, combined strategy-inventory/research/bounded-search suite: 11 passed. Ruff and mypy passed. Full-suite run: 3,539 passed, 1 skipped; 2 inventory freshness checks initially failed and passed on targeted rerun after regeneration.

limitations: The journal applies to the daily bounded search only; other search mechanisms are not yet wired to it.
No full search on the owner's historical dataset or independent reproduction is claimed.
Research records do not establish a deployable edge or authorize strategy promotion.
